technical.summary: CVS shows solid trend structure with price above all major MAs and ADX confirmation, but lacks momentum confirmation from MACD and faces overbought conditions on longer RSI; suitable for pullback entry rather than breakout.

fundamental.summary: CVS shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces elevated earnings risk in 33 days with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; balanced market sentiment (AAII neutral, Fear/Greed 49) offers neither contrarian opportunity nor warning; insufficient news data to confirm or contradict setup.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (301.12) with imminent NFP event (0 days) creates acute volatility risk; normal yield curve provides limited offset; 33-day earnings window adds secondary event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with ADX confirmation and multi-timeframe RSI bullish alignment provides solid trend structure suitable for pullback entry near support at 86.95.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis (301.12), imminent NFP event, overbought RSI-21, negative MACD histogram, zero fundamental conviction, and weak entry quality create unacceptable risk/reward despite technical setup.
debate.price_positioning: middle_of_range — moderate entry quality with support 86.95 and resistance 89.81 defining narrow swing window

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows price above all major MAs with ADX confirmation, but this is insufficient to justify entry given extreme macro headwinds and zero fundamental support.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme VIX crisis (301.12) combined with imminent NFP event and 33-day earnings window creates unacceptable volatility risk that outweighs technical structure.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on elevated risk and weak conviction
